phone.alone.welcome.title: Nocturne remembers your day
phone.alone.welcome.lead: Keep notes, photos and voice notes, write your journal, and see your calendar beside your days.
phone.alone.start.title: Your memory lives on this phone
phone.alone.start.works.keep: Keep notes, photos and voice notes
phone.alone.start.works.journal: Write your journal and check in
phone.alone.start.works.calendar: See your calendar and health beside your days
phone.alone.start.works.find: Find anything you kept by its words
phone.alone.start.waitsHint: A mind can come from Nocturne on your own computer. Your memory then moves there.
phone.alone.start.lostPhone: If this phone is lost, what you kept goes with it. Save a backup now and then in {thisPhone}.
phone.alone.offer.lead: Nocturne can show what’s in this phone’s calendar and health readings beside your days. Both are optional. You can change your mind any time in {thisPhone}.
phone.alone.calendar.why.title: Show your calendar in Nocturne?
phone.alone.calendar.why.where: It stays on this phone, in Nocturne’s memory, and goes wherever your memory goes: into a locked copy or to a mind, only if you turn those on.
phone.alone.calendar.why.for: Today shows what’s on, and your journal shows each appointment at its time. Each line shows which calendar it came from.
phone.alone.today.status: Your memory is on this phone
phone.alone.today.empty: Nothing kept yet today. Tap {keep} to keep something.
phone.alone.noMind.title: Your page needs a mind to write it.
phone.alone.noMind.body: A mind reads what you keep, writes this page each morning and answers your questions.
phone.alone.reminder.body: No backup yet. If this phone is lost, what you kept goes with it.
phone.alone.find.above: Found by their words. Answers need a mind.
phone.alone.find.none: Nothing you kept has those words.
phone.alone.find.before: Find anything you kept by its words.
phone.alone.find.empty: Nothing kept yet. What you keep can be found here by its words.
phone.alone.thisPhone.can: Your memory is on this phone. It can keep, find, forget and delete, and save a backup to a file.
phone.alone.thisPhone.removing: Removing the app removes your memory from this phone. Save a backup first.
phone.alone.thisPhone.restoreHint: What’s on this phone now is put aside first, never deleted.
phone.alone.delete.title: Delete everything on this phone?
phone.alone.delete.body: Everything you kept, your journal, check-ins, calendar and health readings in Nocturne go from this phone for good. Your calendar and Health themselves aren’t touched. A backup you saved elsewhere isn’t touched.
phone.alone.mind.title: Give Nocturne a mind
phone.alone.mind.lead: A mind reads what you keep, writes your page each morning and answers your questions. It can run on a computer of your own.
phone.alone.mind.step2: Choose {addAPhone} there, and scan its code from this phone.
phone.alone.mind.step3: Your memory moves to the computer, and this phone works with it.
phone.alone.backup.title: Save a backup
phone.alone.backup.lead: One file with everything you kept, locked with a passphrase you choose. Keep it somewhere other than this phone.
phone.alone.backup.next: Next, choose where to save it.
phone.alone.restore.title: Bring back your memory
phone.alone.restore.lead: Choose your backup file and type its passphrase.
phone.alone.restore.done.title: Your memory is back on this phone.
phone.alone.restore.done.body: {count} things, every page and your journal.
phone.alone.damaged.title: Nocturne couldn’t open your memory on this phone.
phone.alone.damaged.body: Nothing was deleted. Bring back a backup, or ask for help.
phone.alone.start.failed: Nocturne couldn’t make your memory on this phone. Free some room, then try again.
phone.alone.keep.kept.note: It’s on today’s journal, and Ask can find it by its words.
phone.alone.keep.kept.waiting: It’s on today’s journal, waiting to be read.
phone.alone.keep.kept.heard: It’s on today’s journal, in words this phone heard.
phone.alone.journal.empty.body: Anything you keep shows up here.
phone.alone.keep.big.body: Nocturne keeps files up to 50 MB.
phone.alone.keep.failed.title: That wasn’t kept.
phone.alone.keep.full: There wasn’t room to keep this. Free some room and try again.
phone.alone.keep.micDenied: The microphone is off for Nocturne in your phone’s settings.
phone.alone.original.cantShow: This one can’t be shown here. Save a copy to open it in another app.
phone.alone.original.cut: Only the start is shown here. Save a copy to read the rest in another app.
phone.alone.original.document.hint: It opens in your phone’s viewer.
phone.alone.original.found: The highlighted words are what you looked for.
phone.alone.private.hint: Never sent to a mind you use online or borrow at home. If your memory moves, it moves too, locked like the rest.
phone.alone.private.journal: Journal entries can’t be marked private.
phone.alone.health.why.title: Show health readings in Nocturne?
phone.alone.health.why.where: They stay on this phone, in Nocturne’s memory, and go wherever your memory goes: into a backup you save, a locked copy or a mind, only if you turn those on.
phone.alone.health.why.for: Your journal shows how you slept and moved beside what you wrote, and Today shows last night’s sleep.
phone.alone.health.done.body: Readings show in your journal and on Today. The first 30 days can take a minute.
phone.alone.health.doneIos.body: Readings show in your journal and on Today.
phone.alone.rationale.why: To show your readings beside your journal and last night’s sleep on Today, on this phone.
phone.alone.rationale.where: Readings stay on this phone, in Nocturne’s memory, and in any backup you save. Nobody else receives them, including the people who make Nocturne. Nocturne has no account, no ads and no analytics.
phone.alone.rationale.keeping: Nocturne keeps readings on this phone until you delete them.
phone.alone.sources.already: What Nocturne already kept stays until you delete it.
phone.alone.replace.title: Replace what’s on this phone?
phone.alone.replace.body: Restoring puts what’s on this phone now aside, then brings in the backup. Nothing is deleted. You can bring back what was here from {thisPhone}.
phone.alone.voice.android: Next, Android asks to let Nocturne use the microphone. Nocturne records only while you hold Record, and turns voice notes into words on this phone.
phone.alone.voice.iphone: Next, iPhone asks to let Nocturne recognise speech. Nocturne asks for it on this iPhone only, so your voice notes become words without leaving it.
phone.alone.rationale.stopping: Turn Health off in Nocturne’s {thisPhone}, or take the permission back in Health Connect. To delete readings already kept, use {deleteReadings} in {thisPhone}.
phone.alone.restore.newer.body: It was made with a newer Nocturne than this phone has. Update Nocturne on this phone, then try again. Nothing was changed.
phone.alone.restore.noRoom.body: This phone needs more free space to restore this backup. Free some space, then check again.
phone.alone.welcome.deleted: Everything was deleted from this phone.
phone.alone.full.title: This phone is nearly full.
phone.alone.full.body: Free some room so Nocturne can keep more.
phone.alone.putAside.unread: Nocturne couldn’t open this, so it can’t be brought back.
phone.alone.bringBack.body: What’s on this phone now is put aside instead, so you can still change your mind.
phone.alone.putAside.delete.body: {things, plural, one {# thing kept} other {# things kept}}, {entries, plural, one {# journal entry} other {# journal entries}} and {media, plural, one {# photo or recording} other {# photos and recordings}} from before {day}. This can’t be undone.
phone.alone.putAside.delete.unread: What was put aside {day} couldn’t be opened. Deleting it can’t be undone.
phone.alone.forget.body: {count, plural, one {This will be deleted from this phone for good, along with anything Nocturne worked out from it.} other {These will be deleted from this phone for good, along with anything Nocturne worked out from them.}}
phone.alone.deleteKept.title.calendar: Delete what Nocturne kept from your calendar?
phone.alone.deleteKept.title.health: Delete the health readings Nocturne kept?
phone.alone.deleteKept.lead: It goes from this phone for good.
phone.alone.deleteKept.rows.calendar: {count, plural, one {# appointment} other {# appointments}} from your calendar, and their earlier versions
phone.alone.deleteKept.rows.health: {count, plural, one {# health reading} other {# health readings}}
phone.alone.deleteKept.alsoStop: Also stop showing your calendar in Nocturne
phone.alone.deleteKept.alsoStop.hint: If you leave this off, the next two weeks come back the next time Nocturne opens.
phone.alone.deleteKept.untouched.health: Health on your phone isn’t touched, and nor is a backup you saved.
phone.alone.deleteKept.lead.health: They go from this phone for good.
phone.alone.deleteKept.alsoStop.health: Also stop bringing health readings into Nocturne
phone.alone.deleteKept.alsoStop.health.h: If you leave this off, new readings keep coming in. The ones you delete aren’t brought in again.
phone.alone.deleteKept.untouched.calenda: Your phone’s calendar isn’t touched, and nor is a backup you saved.
phone.alone.putAside.title: Put aside {day}
phone.alone.putAside.lead: What was on this phone before a backup was brought back. {size}.
phone.alone.bringBack.title: Bring back what was put aside {day}?
phone.alone.putAside.delete.title: Delete what was put aside {day}?
phone.alone.permissions.title: Your phone’s permissions
phone.alone.permissions.android: Nocturne reads your calendar and Health, and uses the microphone, only while your phone allows it. To take that back: your calendar and the microphone in Settings, then Apps, then Nocturne, then Permissions; Health in Health Connect, then App permissions, then Nocturne.
phone.alone.permissions.iphone: Nocturne reads your calendar and Health, and uses the microphone and speech recognition, only while your iPhone allows it. To take that back: your calendar, the microphone and speech recognition in Settings, then Nocturne; Health in the Health app, then Sharing, then Apps, then Nocturne.
phone.alone.welcome.stillAllowed: Your phone still lets Nocturne {what} until you take that back.
phone.alone.welcome.what.cm: read your calendar and use the microphone
phone.alone.welcome.what.hm: read Health and use the microphone
phone.alone.welcome.what.chm: read your calendar and Health, and use the microphone
